Use case: stylized-concept
Asset: pure environment scene for Vicky scene library.
An empty airy sea-palace cloister with pearl-white arches, understated carved shell geometry, blue-silver details, shallow clear tidal channels beside a broad matte stone walkway, horizon of pale blue sea and distant delicate island towers, early morning glow. Place for characters to stand; no glossy mirror floor, no extravagant gold.
Premium dimensional 3D romance game environment, airy dreamlike quality, physically tactile materials, pearl white stone, restrained fine silver and warm wood, soft lavender/seafoam accents, broad soft light, luminous exposure preserving texture, low contrast shadows, very subtle halation. Elegant, intimate and spatially plausible, not a cluttered game splash art, not dark or greasy. Single full-bleed landscape 1536x1024 image, not a grid.
Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
